column1: # 3,611 COREPRESENTATIONS over the 870 isolated high-symmetry k-stars of
# the 162 space groups that seat any -- the physically irreducible phonon
# levels once TIME REVERSAL is admitted.  COMPUTED end to end; no
# representation, corepresentation or k-point table is read.
# SPINLESS (T^2 = +1) and NONMAGNETIC.  W is the NORMALISED indicator of
# Bilbao's Representations DSG (Elcoro et al. 2017, eq. 13), divided by
# |G_k|; it is NOT Bradley & Cracknell eq. (7.3.48) or MTQC's J_sigma.
# WHAT IS CHECKED, AND WHAT IS NOT.  Verified by corep_derive.py --selftest:
#   the SIGNED sum rule, whose right-hand side touches no character table
#     -- holds on all 828 stars with an antiunitary coset;
#   the case-(c) pairing, fixed-point-free on all 828;
#   21 stars measured out of an actual DYNAMICAL MATRIX, with a complex
#     Hermitian control that breaks only time reversal -- 0 mismatches;
#   the published rows of sg 19, 76, 144, 227 and 230.
# Agreement with captures/PHONON-KGROUND.tsv over the 7 non-Gamma TRIMs of
# all 230 space groups (230 of 230) is measured by a separate script and is
# NOT re-run by this file's selftest.  Neither is the set-wise identity of
# the stars with kpoint_derive's grid-free enumeration (230 of 230).
